purpose: Classifies gateway OpenAPI operations that do not yet have dedicated PHP SDK request classes before public TypeScript SDK generation.
source_of_truth: Gateway API route/controller behavior remains authoritative. This file classifies SDK-generation intent; it does not generate or bless routes by itself.

classification_values.public_sdk: Public SDK surface. A dedicated PHP SDK request class should be added before using the generated public TypeScript SDK broadly.
classification_values.internal_only: Gateway/runtime internal route. Do not expose as public SDK surface or generated public TypeScript SDK method.
classification_values.deferred_optional: Optional, extension, admin, or sensitive route. Keep out of the first public TypeScript SDK unless a later slice promotes it explicitly.

conventions.destructive_consent: Destructive consent and destructive options are request body fields when the gateway reads request input or uses FormRequest validation.
conventions.classification_scope: Only schema operations without a dedicated PHP SDK request class are listed here. Existing PHP SDK request classes remain covered by their SDK tests.
